title: Minimum Garden Perimeter to Collect Enough Apples
description: Find the minimum perimeter of a square plot centered at (0,0) to collect at least neededApples.
pseudocode:
1. side = 1
2. while apples(side) < neededApples:
3.   side += 1
4. return side * 8

steps.note: Calculate apples for n=1: 0 < 1 is true. Proceed to increment.
Calculate apples for n=2: 12 >= 1. Condition fails, loop terminates.
